title: PaySaathi 1.2.2 — Business workspaces and team controls
notes: Added a separate tenant-scoped Business Admin workspace for business owners and administrators; it is separate from the platform-wide admin console.

Added tenant team management for existing active PaySaathi accounts, with owner-only administrator assignment, plan member limits and duplicate-membership protection. Email invitations are not yet enabled.
Signed-in workspace branding now applies on the shared PaySaathi host as well as verified custom hostnames.
Business owners retain read-only workspace and team visibility after a trial expires, while operational tenant access and adding new members remain blocked.
Tenant isolation now covers 29 operational tables with 29 restrictive tenant policies and 34 validated tenant foreign keys; audit found zero legacy rows missing tenant ownership.
Verified that cross-tenant writes are rejected, tenant member listing is restricted to workspace administrators, and non-owner administrators cannot create other administrators.
Custom-domain TXT verification confirms ownership only; automatic DNS routing and SSL provisioning are not yet enabled.
Live subscription checkout, recurring billing, automatic paid-plan activation, email invitations and production tenant routing are not yet integrated.
Payment and regulated services remain disabled until verified providers and required compliance integrations are configured.
